name: Thrizer vs Reimbursify
title: Thrizer vs Reimbursify: Out-of-Network Billing Comparison (2026)
description: Compare Thrizer and Reimbursify for out-of-network therapy billing. See differences in pricing, co-pay models, claim submission, and which is best for your cash-pay practice.

summary.bottom_line: Thrizer lets clients pay just a co-pay upfront (Thrizer fronts the rest), making therapy more affordable and increasing client retention. Reimbursify is a simpler claim submission tool where clients still pay full rates upfront and wait for reimbursement. Thrizer is better for client affordability; Reimbursify is cheaper for basic superbill submission.

key_differences.payment_model: Thrizer (co-pay upfront) vs Reimbursify (full rate upfront)
key_differences.risk_model: Thrizer (absorbs denial risk) vs Reimbursify (client bears risk)
key_differences.complexity: Thrizer (requires payment platform switch) vs Reimbursify (works with existing setup)

sections.heading: Thrizer vs Reimbursify: Overview
sections.content: Thrizer and Reimbursify both help therapy clients get reimbursed for out-of-network sessions, but they work very differently. Thrizer acts as a payment platform that lets clients pay just their estimated co-pay upfront—Thrizer fronts the rest and waits for the insurance reimbursement. Reimbursify is a straightforward claim submission tool where clients pay the full session rate and submit claims to get reimbursed later. The difference in client experience is significant.

sections.heading: Payment Model: The Key Difference
sections.content: Thrizer's model is unique: instead of clients paying $200/session and waiting weeks for a $140 reimbursement check, clients pay only their estimated $60 co-pay at each session. Thrizer pays the therapist the full rate immediately and takes on the risk of waiting for (and potentially not receiving) the insurance reimbursement. This makes therapy dramatically more affordable for clients session-to-session. Reimbursify doesn't offer this—clients pay the full rate upfront and wait for reimbursement via check in the mail.

sections.heading: Claim Denial Protection
sections.content: Thrizer offers protection that Reimbursify doesn't. Since Thrizer takes on the risk of waiting for reimbursements, they absorb claim denials too—their strict no-back-charges policy means neither the client nor therapist is hit with unexpected bills if a claim is denied. With Reimbursify, if a claim is denied, the client has already paid the full session rate and simply doesn't get reimbursed. Reimbursify only refunds the claim submission fee.

sections.heading: Pricing Comparison
sections.content: Thrizer charges $2 per claim until the client hits their deductible, then $3.50 per claim (with a small 1% fee post-deductible). No monthly fees. The benefits calculator is free. Reimbursify charges $3.99 per claim (or $2.99 if you buy in bulk), plus $59-99/month if you want their benefits calculator and courtesy claim submissions. Reimbursify also requires a 3-month commitment for monthly plans. For cost-conscious practices, Thrizer's per-claim model with no monthly fees is often more economical.

sections.heading: Which Should You Choose?
sections.content: The choice depends on what problem you're trying to solve:

recommendations.when: You want to make therapy more affordable for clients (co-pay model), you want protection against claim denials, you're willing to switch to Thrizer's payment platform, or you want clients to stop dropping out due to upfront costs

You just need basic superbill submission, your clients can afford to pay full rates upfront and wait for reimbursement, you don't want to change your existing payment setup, or you want the simplest possible solution
You want fully managed claim submission without changing your payment platform—Mentaya handles everything but doesn't offer Thrizer's co-pay model

faqs.q: What's the main difference between Thrizer and Reimbursify?
faqs.a: The main difference is the payment model. With Thrizer, clients pay only their co-pay upfront and Thrizer fronts the rest (waiting for reimbursement on their behalf). With Reimbursify, clients pay the full session rate upfront and then submit claims to get reimbursed later. Thrizer makes therapy more immediately affordable.

faqs.q: What happens if a claim is denied with Thrizer vs Reimbursify?
faqs.a: With Thrizer, claim denials are absorbed by Thrizer—they have a no-back-charges policy, so neither you nor your client owes anything extra. With Reimbursify, if a claim is denied, the client doesn't get reimbursed (they've already paid full price). Reimbursify only refunds the submission fee.

faqs.q: Do I have to change my payment system to use Thrizer?
faqs.a: Yes, Thrizer requires you to use their payment platform to enable the co-pay model (they need to process payments to front the rest). Reimbursify works with your existing payment setup since it's just a claim submission tool.

faqs.q: Which is cheaper: Thrizer or Reimbursify?
faqs.a: Thrizer is often cheaper overall: $2-3.50 per claim with no monthly fees and a free benefits calculator. Reimbursify charges $3.99/claim (or $2.99 bulk) plus $59-99/month for their benefits calculator, with a 3-month commitment required.
